title: Plan trade fair presence on site » For exhibitors
html:
Don’t leave anything to chance. You can plan your trade fair appearance properly with our diverse range of services. Customise your trade fair stand so that it is just the way you want it to be it. Choose from different stand sizes, equipment options and furnishing elements – all tailored to your company and your budget.

Impress your visitors and partners with our bespoke catering services and find out more about our comprehensive stand services. From seamless logistics to the right technical equipment and attractive stand furniture, our services offer you convenience and give your trade fair appearance the perfect finishing touch. Don’t miss any deadlines and order your exhibitor passes and stand construction passes simply and easily.

Promote your trade fair appearance with a little extra – the right advertising for your stand. Find out about our comprehensive range of advertising and PR services. They guarantee that you will impress your customers.
